name: Carpe Diem

rounds.endCondition: Four scoring periods then final scoring

categories.label: Score track after 4 scoring periods
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track sau 4 kỳ chấm
categories.hint: VP tracked during play (scoring cards, penalties of -4 per unmet card).

categories.label: Completed villas (chimney table)
categories.hint: Sum VP from your overview board table per completed villa by chimneys; incomplete villas score 0.

categories.label: Remaining items (wares, coins, bread, building tiles)
categories.hint: Count items on storage; 1 VP per 2 items, rounded down.

categories.label: Banderole bar position
categories.hint: VP shown on the space with your disc.

categories.label: Fountain cards
categories.hint: VP from both fountain cards (2 VP per matching building in your district for the cards shown).

categories.label: Frame achievements
categories.hint: 3-4 VP per frame goal whose line hits a completed matching building/landscape.

tiebreakers.description: Among tied players, the one furthest back (last) on the banderole bar wins.

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Villa chimney table and frame goal values are printed on player boards (example: 3 chimneys=3 VP, 5 chimneys=7 VP; baker dwelling goal 4 VP, villa goal 3 VP), so entered as totals. Score track covers the four in-game scoring periods. Tiebreaker needs banderole rank, not modelled as a category.
